title: Bytecode
fileHelp: Saved PHP, Kotlin and Java source is compiled without executing it. Existing class, PHB and JAR files are read as saved. Unsaved editor changes are not included.
buildHelp: Reads the current or latest available build output. This is a saved artifact snapshot, not running process memory or live JIT code.
stale: Result is out of date. Refresh to inspect again.
noProject: Open a project to inspect bytecode.
noBuild: No build output is available. Build the project, then refresh.
noFiles: No supported files were found in this project.
chooseFile: Choose a file and inspect its bytecode.
sourceUnavailable: Select an instruction with a known project source line.
noMethods: This class has no visible methods.
showDebugInfoHelp: Show source line numbers, local variables, signatures and exception handler ranges when present in the class file.
showSyntheticHelp: Include compiler generated classes, methods and fields marked as synthetic.
filesFailed: Could not load files. Try refreshing the list.
noClasses: This artifact has no visible classes.
copyManually: Instructions selected. Press Ctrl+C to copy.
instructionIndexHelp: The first column is an instruction index, not a binary byte offset. Compact JVM forms are shown as their base operation, for example ILOAD_0 as ILOAD 0.

errors.NO_PROJECT: Open a project to inspect bytecode.
errors.PROJECT_CHANGED: The project changed. Select the file again.
errors.FILE_CONFLICT: The file changed. Refresh its bytecode.
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file is no longer available.
errors.BYTECODE_INVALID: The selected file does not contain valid JVM bytecode.
errors.BYTECODE_UNSUPPORTED: This file type cannot be inspected.
errors.BYTECODE_LIMIT: The selected artifact exceeds the viewer limit.
errors.BYTECODE_FAILED: Could not prepare bytecode. See the error details.
errors.BYTECODE_JOB_EXPIRED: The result expired. Refresh its bytecode.
